description_en: Modifies the SNAT configurations of a WAN port of a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) device
description_zh: 修改智能接入网关设备WAN口的SNAT配置
kebab_example: aliyun smartag modify-sag-wan-snat --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-whfn0000 --smart-ag-sn sag32a300000 --snat ENABLE --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySagWanSnat

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the SAG device associated with the SAG instance
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: smart_ag_sn

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable SNAT. Valid values:

ENABLE: enables SNAT.

DISABLE: disables SNAT
parameters.help_zh:
是否打开SNAT功能。取值：

ENABLE：开启SNAT功能。

DISABLE：关闭SNAT功能
parameters.name: snat
